title: Mean-field Token Steering
abstract: arXiv:2611.19163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We consider stochastic token steering through a deep stack of transformer layers as a mean-field control problem for an interacting particle system on the unit sphere, where interactions arise from the attention mechanism. In the mean-field limit, the token population evolves via a controlled integro-partial differential equation where the feedback control acts as a corrective vector field guiding the population toward an aggregate configuration of tokens in the representation space. We deduce the minimum effort control to accomplish this task over a fixed time horizon interpreted as normalized layer depth. We show that the resulting controlled dynamics for the token population can be understood as a mean-field Schr\"odinger bridge adapted to the sphere geometry. translated_abstract: 我们将通过深层 Transformer 层堆栈的随机词元引导视为单位球面上相互作用粒子系统的平均场控制问题，其中相互作用源于注意力机制。在平均场极限下，词元群体通过一个受控的积分-偏微分方程演化，其中反馈控制作为校正向量场，引导词元群体趋向表示空间中的词元聚合构型。我们推导了在固定时间范围（被解释为归一化层深度）内完成该任务所需的最小努力控制。我们证明所得的词元群体受控动力学可被理解为适配球面几何的平均场薛定谔桥。在此基础上，我们提出了一种动态 Sinkhorn 递推的新颖推广方法，用于计算一致的词元演化。数值实验证实了所提出的方法。
tldr: 该论文将 Transformer 深层中的随机词元引导建模为单位球面上相互作用粒子系统的平均场最小努力控制问题，证明其受控动力学等价于适配球面几何的平均场薛定谔桥，并提出动态 Sinkhorn 递推的新推广方法来计算一致的词元演化。
en_tdlr: This paper formulates stochastic token steering through deep transformer layers as a minimum-effort mean-field control problem for interacting particles on the unit sphere, shows the controlled dynamics is a mean-field Schrödinger bridge adapted to the sphere geometry, and proposes a novel generalization of the dynamic Sinkhorn recursion to compute the consistent token evolution.
